title: Correction to: The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and the Forest Service: Insights for Local Job Creation and Equity from the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act
content: This is a correction to: Susan Charnley and others, The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and the Forest Service: Insights for Local Job Creation and Equity from the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act, Journal of Forestry, Volume 121, Issue 3, May 2023, Pages 282–291, https://doi.org/10.1093/jofore/fvad009
